item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las yi dam b+hu ru drag po'i sgrub gzhung 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor
item.coloph: slob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi bcud mchog yin/ gar dbang dbal phur gser gyi snying po 'di/ mkha' spyod zhing dag mkha' 'gro yum cig gi (gis) dus mtha'i 'phags btsun snying med khong dge ba/ kho bo pad ma g.yung drung bdag nyid la/ rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung yang sprul pa/ dmu rje gtsug phud mtshan gyi (gyis) bskul ba'i ngor/ dngos grub tshul du 'gro ba'i yi ger bkod/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog nyes chad bka'i bya ra tshogs la bshags/ 'gro kun pad+ma'i gling du sangs rgyas shog ces shing sbrul zla u0f1etshes 24bzang po la mdangs dar nyi ma'i gling la bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
